cases.question: Tornado warning in Midland County. Triage critical lifeline infrastructure: count hospital hexes and substation hexes in high tornado risk zones. Report resource gap.
cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
SELECT
  COUNT(CASE WHEN h.hifld_health_hospitals_n > 0 THEN c.hex_id END) AS hospital_hex_count,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN s.hifld_energy_substations_n > 0 THEN c.hex_id END) AS substation_hex_count
FROM hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk c
JOIN HP_TOR_001 t ON c.hex_id = t.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-HEALTH-HOSP-N" h ON c.hex_id = h.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" s ON c.hex_id = s.hex_id
WHERE c.County = 'Midland'
  AND t.nri_tornado > 0.5
```

cases.question: Wildfire threatening Midland County. Identify the highest-risk fire zones and assess power infrastructure exposure. Does the county have sufficient first responder resources to cover the threatened area?
cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
SELECT
  c.hex_id,
  c."County",
  c."State",
  f.crown_fire_prob,
  e1.hifld_energy_plants_n,
  e2.hifld_energy_substations_n,
  e3.hifld_energy_tx_km_230p,
  fr1."hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n",
  fr2."hifld_local_emergency_operations_center_local_eoc_n",
  fr3."hifld_local_law_enforcement_n",
  fr4."hifld_national_shelter_system_facilities_shelter_locations_n",
  fr5."hifld_state_emergency_operations_centers_n"
FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" c
JOIN "crown_fire_probability" f ON c.hex_id = f.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-PLANTS-N" e1 ON c.hex_id = e1.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-SUBSTN-N" e2 ON c.hex_id = e2.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-ENERGY-TXKM-230P" e3 ON c.hex_id = e3.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-FIRE_EMS-N" fr1 ON c.hex_id = fr1.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-LOCAL_EOC-N" fr2 ON c.hex_id = fr2.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-LOCAL_LAW-N" fr3 ON c.hex_id = fr3.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-SHELTER-N" fr4 ON c.hex_id = fr4.hex_id
LEFT JOIN "HIFLD-EMERGENC-STATE_EOC-N" fr5 ON c.hex_id = fr5.hex_id
WHERE c."County" LIKE '%Midland%'
ORDER BY f.crown_fire_prob DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

```sql
    WHERE f."nri_coastal_flood" > 0.5 OR f."nri_riverine_flood" > 0.5

buildings_at_risk AS (
    SELECT SUM(e."building_count") AS total_buildings_at_risk
    FROM high_risk_flood_hexes h
    JOIN "EX_BLD_001" e ON h."hex_id" = e."hex_id"
),
flood_eal AS (
    SELECT SUM(v."nri_eal_CFLD") AS total_flood_eal
    FROM high_risk_flood_hexes h
    JOIN "VUL_003" v ON h."hex_id" = v."hex_id"
),
hospitals_in_flood_zone AS (
    SELECT h."hex_id", hifld."hifld_health_hospitals_n"
    FROM high_risk_flood_hexes h
    JOIN "HIFLD-HEALTH-HOSP-N" hifld ON h."hex_id" = hifld."hex_id"
    WHERE hifld."hifld_health_hospitals_n" > 0
)
SELECT 
    b.total_buildings_at_risk,
    f.total_flood_eal,
    h."hex_id" AS hospital_hex_id,
    h."hifld_health_hospitals_n" AS hospital_count
FROM buildings_at_risk b, flood_eal f
LEFT JOIN hospitals_in_flood_zone h ON 1=1;
```

The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
SELECT
```
```sql
    SUM("hifld_fire_and_emergency_medical_service_stations_fire_stations_ems_stations_n") AS "total_fire_stations",
    SUM("hifld_local_law_enforcement_n") AS "total_law_enforcement",
    SUM("hifld_national_shelter_system_facilities_shelter_locations_n") AS "total_shelters",
    SUM("nri_ealpe_TRND") AS "at_risk_population",
```

```sql
LEFT JOIN "CRIT_LIFE_001" cr1 ON c."hex_id" = cr1."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "CRIT_LIFE_002" cr2 ON c."hex_id" = cr2."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "CRIT_LIFE_003" cr3 ON c."hex_id" = cr3."hex_id"
LEFT JOIN "CRIT_LIFE_004" cr4 ON c."hex_id" = cr4."hex_id"
```

cases.question: A comprehensive statewide compound-disaster event is in progress. Define the maximum-credible compound scenario and recommend top resilience investments across affected regions.
cases.system_answer:
The ReFoRCE baseline produced the following SQL and executed it on DuckDB:

```sql
WITH CompoundRisk AS (
    SELECT
        h."hex_id",
        h."County",
        h."State",
        h."Zipcode",
        COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_RFLD", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_HWAV", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_TRND", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_WFIR", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_ERQK", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_CFLD", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_CWAV", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_DRGT", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_HAIL", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_HRCN", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_ISTM", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_LNDS", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_LTNG", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_SWND", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_TSUN", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_VLCN", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_WNTW", 0) AS total_hazard_exposure,
        COALESCE(v2."sovi", 0) + COALESCE(v4."psvi_score", 0) AS vulnerability_index,
        COALESCE(ep."population_7km", 0) AS population_exposure,
        COALESCE(cl2."hex_fc_max_grocery", 0) + COALESCE(cl2."hex_fc_max_hospital", 0) AS critical_life_gap,
        (COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_RFLD", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_HWAV", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_TRND", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_WFIR", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_ERQK", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_CFLD", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_CWAV", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_DRGT", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_HAIL", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_HRCN", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_ISTM", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_LNDS", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_LTNG", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_SWND", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_TSUN", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_VLCN", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_WNTW", 0)) *
        (COALESCE(v2."sovi", 0) + COALESCE(v4."psvi_score", 0)) *
        COALESCE(ep."population_7km", 0) AS compound_risk_score
    FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" h
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_003" v3 ON h."hex_id" = v3."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_002" v2 ON h."hex_id" = v2."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_004" v4 ON h."hex_id" = v4."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "EX_POP_001" ep ON h."hex_id" = ep."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "CRIT_LIFE_002" cl2 ON h."hex_id" = cl2."hex_id"
)
SELECT
    "hex_id",
    "County",
    "State",
    "Zipcode",
    ROUND("total_hazard_exposure", 4) AS "total_hazard_exposure",
    ROUND("vulnerability_index", 4) AS "vulnerability_index",
    "population_exposure",
    ROUND("critical_life_gap", 4) AS "critical_life_gap",
    ROUND("compound_risk_score", 4) AS "compound_risk_score",
    CASE
        WHEN "total_hazard_exposure" > 100000 THEN 'Priority: Flood & Wildfire mitigation, evacuation route hardening'
        WHEN "vulnerability_index" > 0.8 THEN 'Priority: Social support programs, affordable housing resilience, community health centers'
        WHEN "critical_life_gap" > 50 THEN 'Priority: Decentralize critical life support facilities, mobile response units'
        ELSE 'Priority: Integrated early warning systems, cross-sector infrastructure upgrades'
    END AS "recommended_investment"
FROM CompoundRisk
WHERE "compound_risk_score" > 0
ORDER BY "compound_risk_score" DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

WITH CompoundRisk AS (
    SELECT
        h."hex_id",
        h."County",
        h."State",
        h."Zipcode",
        COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_RFLD", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_HWAV", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_TRND", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_WFIR", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_ERQK", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_CFLD", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_CWAV", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_DRGT", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_HAIL", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_HRCN", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_ISTM", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_LNDS", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_LTNG", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_SWND", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_TSUN", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_VLCN", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_WNTW", 0) AS total_hazard_exposure,
        COALESCE(v2."sovi", 0) + COALESCE(v4."psvi_score", 0) AS vulnerability_index,
        COALESCE(ep."population_7km", 0) AS population_exposure,
        COALESCE(cl2."hex_fc_max_grocery", 0) + COALESCE(cl2."hex_fc_max_hospital", 0) AS critical_life_gap,
        (COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_RFLD", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_HWAV", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_TRND", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_WFIR", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_ERQK", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_CFLD", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_CWAV", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_DRGT", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_HAIL", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_HRCN", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_ISTM", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_LNDS", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_LTNG", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_SWND", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_TSUN", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_VLCN", 0) + COALESCE(v3."nri_eal_WNTW", 0)) *
        (COALESCE(v2."sovi", 0) + COALESCE(v4."psvi_score", 0)) *
        COALESCE(ep."population_7km", 0) AS compound_risk_score
    FROM "hex_county_state_zip_crosswalk" h
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_003" v3 ON h."hex_id" = v3."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_002" v2 ON h."hex_id" = v2."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "VUL_004" v4 ON h."hex_id" = v4."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "EX_POP_001" ep ON h."hex_id" = ep."hex_id"
    LEFT JOIN "CRIT_LIFE_002" cl2 ON h."hex_id" = cl2."hex_id"
)
SELECT
    "hex_id",
    "County",
    "State",
    "Zipcode",
    ROUND("total_hazard_exposure", 4) AS "total_hazard_exposure",
    ROUND("vulnerability_index", 4) AS "vulnerability_index",
    "population_exposure",
    ROUND("critical_life_gap", 4) AS "critical_life_gap",
    ROUND("compound_risk_score", 4) AS "compound_risk_score",
    CASE
        WHEN "total_hazard_exposure" > 100000 THEN 'Priority: Flood & Wildfire mitigation, evacuation route hardening'
        WHEN "vulnerability_index" > 0.8 THEN 'Priority: Social support programs, affordable housing resilience, community health centers'
        WHEN "critical_life_gap" > 50 THEN 'Priority: Decentralize critical life support facilities, mobile response units'
        ELSE 'Priority: Integrated early warning systems, cross-sector infrastructure upgrades'
    END AS "recommended_investment"
FROM CompoundRisk
WHERE "compound_risk_score" > 0
ORDER BY "compound_risk_score" DESC
LIMIT 20;
